title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash NVFP4 on 8x RTX PRO 5000 72GB (SM120, PCIe, dual NUMA): Marlin workaround, C1-C64 matrix, cache on/off, 1M context

hardware.interconnect: PCIe only, no NVLink; GPU0-3 NODE within NUMA0, GPU4-7 NODE within NUMA1, cross-group SYS
hardware.topology_summary: nvidia-smi topo -m: 4+4 GPUs split across two CPU sockets; all cross-group links report SYS
hardware.cpu_numa: 2 x Xeon Platinum 8488C, 192 threads; GPU0-3 -> NUMA0, GPU4-7 -> NUMA1; 1.5 TB RAM

model.name: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (428B total / 23B active MoE, text/image/video input, 1M context)
model.quantization: MXFP8 dense + NVFP4 packed experts (moe_quant_format=nvfp4-pack-quantized), served as minimax_m3_nvfp4 via Marlin

workload.server_notes: SGLang TP8 + Marlin; --attention-backend triton --chunked-prefill-size 2048 --mem-fraction-static 0.85; cache-on runs use radix cache, cache-off runs use --disable-radix-cache; SM120 requires three read-only patches (see recipes/8x-72gb-pcie.md Case C)

results.config: c64 at 1M context (chunk 2048, prefill graph disabled)
ctx32k_c1 at 1M context (chunk 2048, prefill graph disabled)

variance.note: cache-on: 3 independent launches per label; output throughput spread 0.07%-2.11%. cache-off: 1 launch per label.

methodology: vllm bench serve --backend openai (OpenAI completions), random dataset input 1024 / output 256 (ctx32k: 32768/256; sharegpt: ShareGPT_V3), ignore_eos, temperature 0, seed 42, warmups 10 (ctx32k: 2); cache-on 3 launches, cache-off 1 launch per label; 21 cache-on + 7 cache-off runs, 9,680 requests total, 0 failed; 1M context runs use --context-length 1048576 with chunked-prefill 2048 and prefill CUDA graph disabled.
transferable: On 8x RTX PRO 5000 72GB (SM120, PCIe, dual NUMA), MiniMax-M3.1-Flash NVFP4 can serve via the Marlin workaround; C64 aggregate reached 1060.8 tok/s in this configuration
Prefix cache matters: disabling it cut c8-c64 throughput by 20.5%-22.6% and raised TTFT p50 3.7x-5.8x; ctx32k_c4 throughput dropped 41.9%
1M context is functional: a cold 999,988-token request completed in 517.7 s without OOM; one 1M request consumes ~79% of the 1,329,280-token KV pool, so 1M concurrency is effectively 1
Enabling 1M costs ~23% C64 throughput (815.7 vs 1060.8 tok/s) because prefill graphs are disabled and chunked prefill drops to 2048
not_transferable: Absolute numbers depend on the exact image (dev-minimax-m31-flash), driver/CUDA, and the three SM120 patches
This is the Marlin bf16-compute path, not the SM100 MegaMoE path; SM100/SM103 numbers will differ
The 1M cold-start timing is dominated by prefill at chunk 2048 and will change with chunk size, context length, and prompt content
Results use the completions endpoint (no chat template / reasoning tokens); chat or agent workloads with thinking enabled will be slower per answer
